purpose.domain_detail: Aviation club (aeroclub) pilot management system — French language
purpose.summary: A two-program COBOL file implementing a pilot management menu for an aviation club ('GESTION AEROCLUB'). Program F3 provides a menu to list, add, modify, and delete pilots, calling a utility subprogram UTIL that renders a standard screen header with date/time and current function name.

notable_features: SCREEN SECTION with color attributes (BACKGROUND-COLOR, FOREGROUND-COLOR)
Nested/contained program (PROGRAM-ID UTIL within same file)
French-language UI strings and variable names
Commented-out DISPLAY statements showing iterative development
verdict.notes: No IDENTIFICATION DIVISION keyword is missing — both programs have it. The file contains two programs: F3 (main) and UTIL (utility subprogram). The dialect is likely GnuCOBOL based on SCREEN SECTION syntax and free use of LINE/COL on ACCEPT/DISPLAY, but could also be Micro Focus; no compiler directives to disambiguate. French text and aviation domain suggest a student project. Some commented-out code and incomplete LISTE-PILOTE (just STOP RUN) confirm student/exercise maturity.
